en.name: TinyWalk
en.tagline: Generate step count & health test data on iPhone, for developers testing HealthKit apps.
en.promo: Generate realistic HealthKit step and workout samples on-device, in seconds. No ads, no account.
features: Generate realistic step count & workout samples
Writes directly into HealthKit on your device
No ads, no account — data generation is fully on-device
Built for developers & QA testing HealthKit apps

qa.q: What does this app actually do?
qa.a: TinyWalk is a tool for developers and QA testers: it generates structurally correct step and health test data on your own iPhone, so you can verify apps that read this kind of data.

qa.q: Where does the generated data show up?
qa.a: It's written directly into the Health app, tagged as coming from TinyWalk, and can be deleted anytime from the Health app.
No — it's synthetic test data for your development workflow, not a record of real activity.
The 100-step and 1,000-step datasets are free forever. Unlocking 2,000+ step datasets is a one-time purchase, no subscription.

qa.a: TinyWalk 是給開發者、QA 測試人員用的工具：在你自己的 iPhone 上產生結構正確的步數與健康測試資料，方便驗證會讀取這類資料的 App。

qa.q: 產生的資料會出現在哪裡？
qa.a: 會直接寫進「健康」App，來源標記為 TinyWalk，隨時可以在「健康」App 裡刪除。
不是，是合成的測試資料，用於開發流程測試，不代表真實運動量。
100 步與 1,000 步的資料集永久免費；解鎖 2,000 步以上的資料集是一次性購買，沒有訂閱。

en.name: TrailPop
en.tagline: Turn your trip photos into a fog-of-war travel trail video — 100% on-device.
en.promo: TrailPop turns your trip photos into a turn-by-turn travel trail video. Fog-of-war unfogs as your route progresses, photos pop out in 3D at each stop, and everything renders 100% on your device — nothing uploaded.
features: Reads GPS + timestamp from your photos' EXIF automatically
Real turn-by-turn road navigation trace (MapKit directions)
Fog-of-war map unfogs as your trip progresses
Photos pop out in 3D at each stop
6 transport modes: car, plane, scooter, hiking, train, boat
3 visual themes, 15s–5min export, 9:16 for Reels/TikTok
100% on-device — nothing uploaded

zh-hant.name: TrailPop
zh-hant.tagline: 把旅遊照片變成世界迷霧解鎖的旅行軌跡影片，100% 本機處理。
zh-hant.promo: TrailPop 把旅遊照片變成 turn-by-turn 的旅行軌跡影片。世界迷霧隨路線推進逐步解鎖，每個停靠點相片會 3D 彈出特寫，全程 100% 本機運算，不上傳任何內容。
features: 自動讀取照片 EXIF 的 GPS 座標與拍攝時間
真實道路 turn-by-turn 導航軌跡（MapKit）
世界迷霧隨路線推進動態解鎖
每個景點相片 3D 彈出特寫
6 種交通工具：汽車、飛機、機車、健行、火車、輪船
3 種視覺主題，15 秒～5 分鐘匯出，9:16 適合 Reels/TikTok
100% 本機運算，不上傳伺服器
